# Rift Makers — 3D assets

All 3D models are **Tripo Studio** models owned by the user's Tripo account:

- New generations were made on 2026-10-31 through the user's signed-in Chrome, in the art helper's own tab.
- Reused models were generated on the same account by earlier games, and their provenance is recorded in those repos.

No API, no tokens, no purchase or upgrade, and no other generator was used. All downloads used the normal Export → GLB button.

**Licence basis:** the models were generated by the user's own Tripo account, and their use follows that account's Tripo terms. No community or gallery models were used.

Generated meshes are visual dressing only. Terrain, plates, flows, strata, the sea, gauges and badges are procedural and driven by the pure model.

Visual targets (ChatGPT gpt-image mockups) are described in `docs/visual-targets/PROMPTS.md` and `docs/visual-targets/CHECKLIST.md`.

**Generation settings (every new model):**
- Text prompt.
- HD Model, AI model "H3.1 – Best Quality".
- Texture on at 2K, PBR on, Remove Lighting on.
- Triangle topology, polycount 20000, Ultra Mesh off.
- Privacy: Private.
- The T-Pose toggle was on for the two characters.

**Searching first:**
- The reusable owned models below were found on disk in sibling repos, and their origin was verified against each repo's ASSETS.md (sha256 matches).
- The Tripo "Assets" page has no search box, so it was not scanned exhaustively for an existing hot spring, ammonite, seismograph or tower. None of the sibling repos had one.

## Processing

New models:

```
npx -y @gltf-transform/cli optimize assets-src/tripo/<name>_raw.glb public/models/<name>.glb \
  --compress false --simplify false --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024
```

This is the same recipe as slope-sled. No meshopt and no quantization are used, because they broke the skinned bbox, and plain `GLTFLoader` then loads the files without decoders. The only required extension is `EXT_texture_webp`.

Reused models:
- dog and observatory were re-optimized from their original raw Tripo downloads with the same command.
- boat, house, rocks, olive and cypress only exist on disk as their meshopt-compressed shipped files. They were run through `npx -y @gltf-transform/cli dequantize <src> <out>`, which decodes `EXT_meshopt_compression` and `KHR_mesh_quantization`. The result needs only `EXT_texture_webp`, at the cost of a bigger file.

Source copies are in `assets-src/tripo/` (new raw downloads) and `assets-src/reuse/` (reuse sources, unchanged copies).

All models are Y-up, sit on y = 0, and are about 1 unit at their largest dimension (Tripo normalizes); scale them in code. Characters face **+Z**. Clip names, heights and orientation notes are in `public/models/manifest.json`.

## Per model

### pebble.glb — חצצים pebble villager (NEW, rigged)

- **Prompt (T-Pose on):** "Stylized cartoon game character: a cute little pebble person. The whole body is one big round, smooth, slightly flattened river pebble (like an egg-shaped beach stone), soft light grey with warm sand-colored speckles, polished smooth stone texture. Two big friendly round eyes with white sclera and dark pupils and a small happy smile on the upper front of the stone. Short stubby stone-grey arms with round mitten hands, short stubby legs with round feet. A small bright green leaf tied around the neck area like a scarf. Chunky, bright, clean low-to-mid poly mobile game style, simple readable shapes, smooth hand-painted colors, not realistic, kid-friendly. Full body, standing in T-pose, arms straight out to the sides, legs slightly apart, symmetrical, front view."
- **Result:** exactly on brief. An egg-shaped grey speckled stone with big glossy eyes, a smile and a green leaf scarf. Stubby arms and legs with round hands and feet. 18,838 tris.
- **Rig:**
  - Auto Rig, Humanoid, Mixamo preset. One skin, root node `Armature`.
  - Exported with Export Skeleton on, 6 animations, and "Animation stay in Place" on.
- **Clips in the GLB (exact names, seconds):**
  - `idle` 15
  - `dig` 16 (build/work loop: bends over and digs)
  - `scared_01` 3 (panic)
  - `fall` 3 (falls on its back and stays down)
  - `cheer` 12 (arms up; the body squashes a little, which reads as joy)
  - `walk` 2
- **No get-up preset exists in Tripo's list.** Recover by crossfading from the end of `fall` to `idle`, or by playing `fall` reversed.
- **Bind bbox:** x ±0.5 (T-pose arms), y 0..0.858, z ±0.325. Faces +Z.
- **Sizes:** raw 4,872,676 B → 1,793,240 B.

### scientist.glb — Wegener-style explorer-scientist (NEW, rigged)

- **Prompt (T-Pose on):** "Stylized cartoon game character: a friendly early-1900s polar explorer and geologist scientist, inspired by a classic Arctic expedition scientist. Middle-aged man with a big bushy brown handlebar moustache, kind eyes, short side-parted hair, wearing a thick hooded brown fur parka with a light fur-trimmed hood pushed back, brown wool trousers, sturdy leather lace-up boots, a leather satchel strap across the chest, and a rolled-up paper map tucked in his belt. Chunky, bright, clean low-to-mid poly mobile game style, Pixar-like stylized proportions, simple readable shapes, smooth hand-painted colors, not realistic, kid-friendly. Full body, standing in T-pose, arms straight out to the sides, empty hands, legs slightly apart, symmetrical, front view."
- **Result:** very good. Big moustache, fur-trimmed brown parka, satchel and a map at the hip, leather boots. 19,242 tris.
- **Rig:** Humanoid, Mixamo preset. Stay-in-place export, 6 animations.
- **Clips (exact names, seconds):**
  - `idle` 15
  - `greet_01` 4 (talk/gesture)
  - `agree` 4 (nod)
  - `complain_01` 6 (disagree)
  - `fold_arms` 17 (skeptic)
  - `cheer` 12
- **Critic NPC:** use the same GLB with a tinted material. No second generation was made.
- **Bind bbox:** x ±0.5, y 0..0.997, z ±0.199. Faces +Z.
- **Sizes:** raw 4,573,388 B → 1,876,440 B.

### warning_tower.glb — tsunami/quake warning tower (NEW, static)

- **Prompt:** "Stylized cartoon game prop: a small hilltop earthquake and tsunami warning station. A short sturdy tower of cream limestone blocks about three times taller than wide, with a small square stone hut at its base that has a wooden door and one window showing an old brass seismograph drum recorder with a paper roll and a red ink zig-zag line. On top of the tower a round red-and-white warning siren horn pointing sideways and a small orange warning lamp, plus a thin radio antenna mast. A green shield plaque on the hut wall. Chunky, bright, clean low-to-mid poly mobile game style, simple readable silhouette, smooth hand-painted colors, not realistic, kid-friendly. Single object, isolated, no ground plane, no text."
- **Result:**
  - A cream block tower with an arched wooden door, a green shield plaque, a red/white siren horn, an orange lamp and an antenna on top.
  - The seismograph window did not come out, so a separate seismograph station was generated.
  - There is a small grass disc under the base: sink it into the terrain.
- 19,331 tris. bbox x ±0.464, y 0..1, z ±0.468.
- **Sizes:** 3,053,840 → 598,480 B.

- **Prompt:** "Stylized cartoon game prop: a tiny field seismograph station. A small open-front wooden and stone shed with a slanted tin roof, inside on a sturdy stone pier stands a big old brass drum seismograph: a horizontal rotating paper drum with a red zig-zag ink line, a long pendulum arm with a pen touching the drum. Chunky, bright, clean low-to-mid poly mobile game style, simple readable silhouette, smooth hand-painted colors, not realistic, kid-friendly. Single object, isolated, no ground plane, no text."
- **Result:** excellent. An orange wooden shed on a stone base with a gable roof, a dish and antenna, a brass-ended paper drum with a red zig-zag, a pen arm, and a red pad by the door. The open front faces +Z.
- 18,506 tris. bbox x ±0.404, y 0..1, z ±0.370.

Notes on the reused models:

- **dog**
  - A rigged quadruped (Tripo "Other" rig, 36 joints). The only clip is `preset:quadruped:walk`.
  - The head points to −X.
  - It is the quake-sensing dog: bark and hop are procedural, and running is `walk` with a higher timeScale.
- **observatory:** a stone base with a copper dome. A little snow on the base comes from its original winter game; it is acceptable for a volcano observatory, or tint it.
- **boat:** a red fishing trawler. Its bow points −X as exported.
- **house:** a cream limestone house with a flat roof and a turquoise door facing +Z. It is the ordinary, non-413 house.
- **Rejected candidates:**
  - storm-proof `villager.glb`, `hut.glb`, `beacon.glb` and `lighthouse.glb`: a different, wetter art direction.
  - gene-ranch `villager.glb` (grandma) and `gnoomie.glb`: they don't match the pebble people.
